note: FOUR PIECES CROSSED 60 for the first time and the deceleration reversed: mean delta +4.4 against round 5's +2.4. Freezing the measurement layer is the likeliest cause — three of this round's briefs started from CORRECTED baselines (materials was told it sat at 5.2% clipped, not the 14.07% its critic had reported), so builders chased real defects instead of instrument artefacts. The perf brief landed hard: draw calls 129 -> 88 against a bar of 120, triangles 216k -> 164k, worst-case JS frame 7.7 ms -> 3.4 ms. The lens fix was one boolean — the streak stops being a decal and writes depth — because post-processing cannot recover a depth that was never written, so opt-in was always the wrong structure. That change exposed two bugs that would have made the entire round worthless on an actual phone: the streak length and the CoC normalisation were both correct only in landscape, and portrait doubled the lens strength.
